title: Milad Lab Biomedical Illustration
summary: Museum / journal-figure atlas language for reusable, highlightable lung and airway illustrations on the Milad Lab site.

palette.notes: Flat colours, restrained palette, minimal shading; no photorealism.

visualLanguage.typography: Simple geometric sans for any labels carried in the artwork.
visualLanguage.lineWeights: Clean, uniform weights across anatomy and callouts.
visualLanguage.composition: Landscape unless a figure brief says otherwise.

layerNaming.convention: kebab-case stable slugs; legend codes A1–A4 (base) and B1–B9 (highlight) are UI keys, not filesystem IDs

groupRules.highlight: B* cells, mediators, pathways, disease overlays

siteCompatibility.summary: Interactive /projects cutaway depends on stable kebab slugs, outline PNGs, and the checked-in cutaway canvas size.
constraints: Do not rename published slugs; extend with new kebab-case IDs instead.
Preserve cutaway-neutral.png pixel size (1024×953) unless regenerating all ROIs and site assets together.
Public site data keys in src/data/lungHealthLayers.generated.ts must match layer slugs.
Avoid baking exposure-specific props into reusable base artwork.

agentInstructions: Preserve composition and visual language unless the brief explicitly changes them.
Add biology without rewriting unrelated structures.
Never swap scientific conventions for stylistic embellishment.
Prefer extending the atlas; do not reinvent palette, line weight, or layer taxonomy.
Keep layer slugs compatible with prior figures and the interactive site.
Follow .cursor/skills/lung-legend-template-match/SKILL.md for detection — do not invent flood-fill / chroma pipelines.
iconInterpretation=multiple-adjacent-as-one (A1 trachea wall, B1 epithelium band): one union legend crop searched as a single silhouette — do not split into 2-discrete part templates.

Tier-2 adjacent bands often diverge from the legend glyph; widen ROI to the anatomical band, use soft expected-center priors from expert freehand, and prefer require_match=False / pending over forced FPs.
After an A1/B1 freehand GT exists, rematch also uses that freehand crop as an extra matchTemplate instance so similar adjacent bands elsewhere can be found (legend-glyph alone is not enough).

iconInterpretationPolicy.1-discrete: Single legend glyph; one template file `{slug}.png`.
iconInterpretationPolicy.2-discrete: Two different glyphs in one legend row; crop each part (`{slug}--{part}.png`) and search independently.
iconInterpretationPolicy.multiple-adjacent-as-one: Contiguous repeats or a wall/lining band treated as one structure (A1, B1). Keep a single union legend crop; also rematch with expert freehand-instance crops so similar bands at other loci are recovered. Do not invent part crops or flood-fill detectors.

imageGenPromptTemplates.reason: The legend lab and site pipeline consume authored PNGs + OpenCV template match; they do not run generative image edits. Add prompt packs only when a figure-generation workflow is adopted.

uiBrief.headline: Flat atlas language · kebab layer IDs · evidence-first biology
